I'm happy for the opportunity to define these things and the end of this part of the Clone War.|Dave Filoni| }} '''''The Clone Wars'': Season Seven''' was the seventh season of the animated ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series.{{Instagram|username=lucasfilm|url=p/BwSFXVqgeDJ|name=[[Lucasfilm]]|date=2019-04-15|quote=Loving the new poster art and trailer for Season 7 of #TheCloneWars, coming to #DisneyPlus!|archivefile=File:Season_7_poster_art_instagram.png}} Marketed as '''''The Final Season''''', it is a revival run of twelve episodes that aired on [[Disney+]]. The revival was announced by the series' supervising director, [[Dave Filoni]], on [[July 19]], [[2018]] at San Diego Comic-Con, during a panel commemorating the show's tenth anniversary. The episodes are a continuation of the series after it was cancelled in [[2013]], and include the [[Siege of Mandalore]]. Series stars [[Matt Lanter]], [[Ashley Eckstein]], [[James Arnold Taylor]], [[Dee Bradley Baker]], [[Tom Kane]], [[Sam Witwer]], [[Katee Sackhoff]], and more all returned to lend their voices to the series. ==Development== {{Quote|Without getting too much into detail - because I love the fan speculation - but it would be a real shame to have done all this work and not use it. So we are looking at everything and going over all those scripts we had. I think that the biggest thing for me is "how do we make this show better?" And I think that means examining all the work we had done, the work we were planning on doing, and also trying to honor the work of so many people that were in the middle of making stuff.|[[Dave Filoni]]|{{WebCite|url=https://www.ign.com/articles/2018/08/12/star-wars-rebels-season-4-finale-clone-wars-final-season-revival-disney-dave-filoni|text=Star Wars Rebels Creator Dave Filoni Reveals How Season 4 Almost Ended and His Clone Wars Revival Plans|author=Huver, Scott|date=2018-13-08|work=[[Wikipedia:IGN|IGN]]|archivedate=20180812202220}}}} ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' ran from [[October 3]], [[2008]]{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode001.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Ambush}} until its final regular broadcast episode on [[March 2]], [[2013]],{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep520|text="The Wrong Jedi" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}} following the show's cancellation at the end of its [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|fifth season]].{{SW|url=news/a-new-direction-for-lucasfilm-animation|text=A New Direction for Lucasfilm Animation}} A [[The Clone Wars: The Lost Missions|half-length season]] was available on Netflix on [[March 7]], [[2014]],{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-clone-wars-the-lost-missions-now-on-netflix|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Lost Missions Now on Netflix|nolive=1}} and [[The Clone Wars Legacy|some story arcs]] were released in several different mediums in the following years.{{SW|url=tv-shows/the-clone-wars-legacy|text=''The Clone Wars'' Legacy}} The show was succeeded by ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'',{{SW|url=news/new-animated-series-star-wars-rebels-coming-fall-2014|text=New Animated Series Star Wars Rebels Coming Fall 2014}} which continued the story of [[Clone Wars]] era characters like [[Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Clone Captain]] [[Rex]],{{Rebels|Relics of the Old Republic}} but fans continued asking for more episodes of ''The Clone Wars''.{{SW|url=news/sdcc-2018-12-things-we-learned-from-the-star-wars-the-clone-wars-panel|text=SDCC 2018: 12 Things We Learned from the ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Panel}} A famous hashtag for the campaign was ''#SaveTheCloneWars''.{{Twitter|username=SaveCloneWars|name=The Clone Wars: Season Seven|archivedate=20160703151733}} [[File:Star_Wars_The_Clone_Wars_revival_poster.png|thumb|left|250px|''The Clone Wars Saved'' poster]] An extension of the original series on the [[Disney+]] streaming service was announced at San Diego Comic Con on [[July 19]], [[2018]], during a panel commemorating the show's 10th anniversary. The announcement came with a trailer for the new season and a poster that contained the hashtag ''#CloneWarsSaved'', referencing the fan campaign. A [[StarWars.com]] interview with [[Dave Filoni: Clone Ranger!|Dave Filoni]], the show's supervising director, confirmed that the new season would contain 12 new episodes. One of the story arcs in the season was the [[Siege of Mandalore]], with some scenes about it in the trailer. The arc was originally intended as the show's series finale,{{Twitter|BFree63|status/654689846171070464|[[Brent Friedman]]|quote=It's a reference to Clone Wars' 'lost' series finale, since that arc and last night's ep were both written by @MattMichnovetz|archivefile=File:Friedman-LostSeriesFinale.png}} and takes place days before and during the events of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], including [[Order 66]].[[Ahsoka (novel)|''Ahsoka'']] The arc was referenced in ''Star Wars Rebels''{{Rebels|The Lost Commanders}} and partly adapted in the young-adult novel [[Ahsoka (novel)|''Ahsoka'']]. The author [[E. K. Johnston]] later revealed that she was asked not to write action scenes for the Siege of Mandalore in the book, as unbeknownst to her Lucasfilm was working on the final season.{{WebCite|url=http://www.starwarsreport.com/2019/04/18/live-at-celebration-with-e-k-johnston-swbw-100|text=Live at Celebration with E.K. Johnston – SWBW #100|date=2019-04-18|archivedate=20190824053633}} [[Matt Lanter]], [[Ashley Eckstein]], [[James Arnold Taylor]], and [[Dee Bradley Baker]] were confirmed to be reprising their respective roles as [[Anakin Skywalker]], Ahsoka Tano, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and [[Captain]] Rex by the revival trailer. In August 2018, [[Tom Kane]] confirmed on his [[Wikipedia:Facebook|Facebook]] account that he had recorded lines for five new episodes of the revival, but he did not confirm if he would be reprising his roles as either the Narrator, [[Yoda]], or [[Wullf Yularen]]. He went on to reprise all three roles.{{TCW|Old Friends Not Forgotten}}{{TCW|Shattered}} As of [[November 5]], 2018, recording was still underway according to Eckstein.{{WebCite|url=https://www.cbr.com/star-wars-clone-wars-season-7-ashley-eckstein-interview|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars' Ashley Eckstein Offers an Update on Season 7|author=Damore, Meagan|date=2018-11-05|archivedate=20190716032913}} [[Sam Witwer]] and [[Ray Park]] were later confirmed to be reprising the role of [[Maul]], with the former providing the voice as he had done in previous seasons and the latter performing motion capture reference.{{WebCite|url=https://www.looper.com/201596/the-truth-about-darth-mauls-clone-wars-return-exclusive|text=The truth about Darth Maul's Clone Wars return – Exclusive|author=Gates, Christopher|date=2020-04-14|archivedate=20200420180745}} During production, several of the models, including that of Captain Rex, were tweaked and improved upon based on new animation technology. [[Star Wars Insider 190|''Star Wars Insider'' 190]] later revealed that as of [[June 12]], [[2019]], production of the episodes was still ongoing.[[Star Wars Insider 190|''Star Wars Insider'' 190]] Filoni felt that his experience making ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'' had informed his work on this season.{{WebCite|url=https://io9.gizmodo.com/how-star-wars-the-clone-wars-long-hiatus-and-the-mand-1841833402|text=How ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Long Hiatus, and ''The Mandalorian'', Made It Even Better|author=Lussier, Germain|date=2020-02-24|archivedate=20200224195118}} Even though he was no longer working on the franchise, ''[[Star Wars]]'' creator [[George Lucas]] talked about some series concepts and ideas with Filoni, who endeavored to keep the revival with Lucas' vision so it, along with other projects, could be faithful to the franchise's films and ideologies.{{WebCite|url=https://www.indiewire.com/2020/02/star-wars-the-clone-wars-dave-filoni-interview-1202212493|text='Star Wars: The Clone Wars': Dave Filoni Discusses the Final Eps and George Lucas's Ongoing Mentorship|author=Hersko, Tyler|date=2020-02-20|archivedate=20200221020128}} ==Release and reception== ''The Clone Wars'' revival was the subject of a panel at [[2019]]'s [[Celebration Chicago]], which took place on [[April 14]].{{SW|url=news/animation-panels-at-star-wars-celebration-chicago|text=Lucasfilm To Host Three Animation Panels at ''Star Wars'' Celebration Chicago}} During the panel, behind-the-scenes images and a trailer were shown. The trailer, besides showing more footage of "Ahsoka's Walkabout" and the Siege of Mandalore also confirmed that the revival would include a finished version of the "Bad Batch" arc, initially released as an unfinished story reel, with completed animation. [https://www.heruniverse.com Her Universe] released a new line of clothing based on Season Seven.{{SW|url=news/rundisney-star-wars-rival-run-weekend-themes-revealed-exclusive|text=runDisney ''Star Wars'' Rival Run Weekend Themes Revealed! - Exclusive}} The season premiered on [[Disney+]] on [[February 21]], [[2020]]. Alongside the release, ''[[Clone Wars Download]]''—a series of short videos exploring the episodes—also premiered.{{SWYouTube|series=Clone Wars Download|text=The Bad Batch|video=JtR4T0SHveQ|sw_url=video/clone-wars-download-the-bad-batch}} ==Media== {{Mediacat|from=1|soundcat=Audio files from The Clone Wars: Season Seven|imagecat=Images from The Clone Wars: Season Seven}} ===Episodes=== {|{{Prettytable}} !
